description:
Read which insight alerts reach the coach and how. Before the coach changes anything this returns the defaults, so it never 404s. Check it before concluding a quiet feed means nothing is happening, since alerts may be muted.

Luca operation: GET /api/insights/settings
Required scopes: analytics:read
Required OAuth scope: luca:read; data sensitivity: redacted
Does not require idempotency.
Use workspaceId or workspaceSlug to override the default workspace configured by environment.
name: luca_insights_settings_get
title: Read alert delivery settings
